exampleEn: I didn't want to bring up the subject during dinner.
exampleKo: 저녁식사 중에 그 주제를 언급하고 싶지 않았어요.
gameExamples: It's always awkward when someone decides to bring up politics at a party.
She was afraid to bring up her concerns during the meeting.
He tried to bring up the idea of a vacation, but no one seemed interested.
